title: cafaye service manifest
description: Schema for cafaye.yml, the per-service manifest every cafaye repository carries. A manifest is the one place that declares a service's identity, its core spec constraint, the contract surface it exposes and consumes, and who owns it. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express (long event types must be prefixed by the publishing service; a service never consumes its own events; exposes.api is required for any service that serves traffic) are documented in docs/manifest-conventions.md and enforced by tests/test_specs.py.

name.description: The cafaye namespace name. Also the repository name and the value used as the event envelope `source`.

description.description: One sentence on what the service is for. Shown by `caf new` and by pantry.

language.description: Implementation language, or `spec` for specification-only repositories (core itself, contract-test fixtures).

core.description: Constraint on the core spec version this service was written against, e.g. ^0.1.0. Service CI pins core to a release inside this range.

exposes.description: The contract surface this service publishes. Omit entirely for libraries and specification-only repositories; a service that serves or receives traffic must declare at least one of api/events.

api.description: Repository-relative path to the OpenAPI 3.1 document describing the HTTP surface.

events.description: Event types this service publishes. Two- or three-segment names; see docs/event-naming.md.

consumes.description: Event types this service subscribes to. Delivery is at-least-once, so every consumer must be idempotent.

dependencies.description: Other cafaye services this service builds on. Sync dependencies, not a package manager.

serviceName.description: cafaye namespace rule: lowercase kebab-case, starting with a letter, no trailing separator. 2-40 characters. Reserved: cafaye, caf, kit, core.

eventType.description: Event type: <entity>.<action> (2 segments) or <service>.<entity>.<action> (3 segments, mandatory when the bare entity name is generic enough to collide: key, token, event, file, job, config, webhook). Segments are lowercase snake_case.

semverRange.description: cafaye semver constraint: ^MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, ~MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, >=MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, or an exact MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Prereleases are out of scope for v0.

openapiRef.description: Repository-relative path to an OpenAPI 3.1 document (.yaml, .yml or .json). No leading ./, no absolute paths, no URLs.

version.description: Constraint on the dependency's own contract version.

required.description: false marks a soft dependency: the service runs without it, degraded.

url.description: SSH remote only. HTTPS remotes for cafaye/anywaye repos are a policy violation (PLAN.md §1).

team.description: Owning team in the cafaye namespace.

contact.description: Reachable mailbox for contract and incident questions.
